note: A synonym term the reader splits into two query terms (`covid-test` is `covid` and `test` under fts_terms) can never match one term of a query, so it fails even a diagnostic build before anything is resolved. The first entry, `Kön` -> `sex`, is the allowed twin.
fails_if: `load_search_synonyms` checks only that the term folds non-blank, or splits it at whitespace instead of at the reader's fts_terms boundary, so `covid-test` loads as a key no query term can equal
